issues.where: GROUPING: ...stray incipit of the following formula
issues.problem: The theory fails: the same string ends units 10, 22 and 31, but unit 11 begins indrāgnī (not lokam) and unit 23 begins āśus trivṛt. It is a recurring cue (probably three separate pratīkas lokam / tā / indram citing other mantras), not an opening of the next unit. Keep it with its own unit as a trailing cue; do not merge it into the next unit.

summary: 12 errors, 25 minor. Main: units 10/22/31 closing 'lokaṃ tā indram' translated with added 'Then the fragment'/'फिर'/'को' and its next-formula theory fails (unit 11 starts indrāgnī, unit 23 starts āśus trivṛt): treat as a recurring cue, keep inside its unit as untranslated cue words, do not merge into a neighbour. Others: unit 3 su-śevāḥ wrong w; unit 4 garbled Hindi; unit 5 epithets attached to Aditi instead of tvā; unit 7 'with' missing before vayonādhas; unit 11 'its back' and nom. for acc. dyāvāpṛthivī. Units without issues: 9,12,13,14,18,19,21,25,28,29,30.
